title: Why renewables can’t save the planet | Michael Shellenberger | TEDxDanubia
summary: Michael Shellenberger argues in a TEDx talk that solar and wind need huge amounts of land and mining, and says nuclear power is a better path to protecting both the climate and nature.
why: HN commenters credit it with changing their minds on nuclear power and cite it for the downsides of renewables.

quote.text: it's what changed my mind and therefore in my opinion the best delivery of the argument I'm aware of.
